description: The Same Problems, County After County — That’s a System Failure Over the last few weeks, I’ve traveled from the busy outskirts of Nashville to the quietest corners of our rural counties. I’ve sat in diners in Wilson County, walked through community centers in Putnam, and listened to neighbors in Fentress and Smith.

title: The Same Problems, County after County - Croley For Congress
